steps.message:
FILES: rich/prompt.py:258-264
ROOT CAUSE: `PromptBase.on_validate_error` calls `self.console.print(error)` without explicitly enabling markup. If the console has markup disabled globally, any markup in the `error` message will be printed as raw text.
CHANGE: Modify `self.console.print(error)` to `self.console.print(error, markup=True)`.
TEST: tests/test_prompt.py
